resources.string: 1. Temporarily remove all accounts from the phone (Settings > Accounts: Google, Samsung, Xiaomi, etc.). They can be re-added after setup.
2. Remove any extra users, guest user or work profile.
3. Enable Developer options > USB debugging (on Xiaomi/MIUI also enable "USB debugging (Security settings)").
4. Connect the phone to a PC and run this command:
5. Return to the app and tap "Check again".
• "there are already some accounts on the device": Go to Settings > Accounts & Sync and remove all logged-in accounts (Google, Samsung, Mi, etc.). You can log back in after setup.
• "there are already several users on the device": Remove guest profiles or secondary users in Settings > System > Multiple Users.
